concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-metronome-api-reference-rate-cards-set-the-rate-card-products-order]] - rate-card product sequencing for customer-invoice presentation, with exact request and response routes and an explicit omitted-product behavior gap
warnings: Do not characterize this endpoint as a product-pricing or rate-schedule mutation; the page documents invoice presentation order only.
The page does not establish where products omitted from product_order appear or whether the array must enumerate the complete card.
